title: Crenet AI Asset Ledger Schema
description: Schema for AI asset tracking, supporting hybrid img2img and human post-edit pipelines.

file_name.description: Path or filename of the final shipped asset in the repository.

generation_type.description: The specific pipeline methodology used to create the asset.

base_human_sketch_ref.description: Reference path to the original human concept art (required for img2img).

ai_generation_data.description: Metadata concerning the AI generation phase.

prompt.description: Full prompt text used for AI generation.

model_used.description: The AI model used (e.g., Stable Diffusion XL, Midjourney v6).

human_post_edit_data.description: Metadata concerning human authorship applied after generation.

source_file_ref.description: Path to the layered project file (e.g., .psd, .kra) proving human modification.

modification_description.description: Brief summary of human edits (e.g., 'repainted cockpit highlights, adjusted silhouette').

timestamp_utc.description: UTC timestamp of the ledger entry creation in ISO 8601 format.
